arguments.value: This agreement lets New York Life use Fidelity’s mutual fund information, such as investment objectives, policies, holdings, and performance, when communicating with annuity and life insurance customers and prospective customers. Fidelity supplies the information and sets its format, and New York Life may use it only as provided, with any needed disclaimers or qualifying information, and cannot alter or expand it. In return, Fidelity pays New York Life a quarterly fee based on the average daily assets New York Life holds in the funds, subject to a cap and adjusted if participation agreements end early. Either party can terminate the agreement under stated notice provisions, Fidelity can end it immediately in certain circumstances, and the agreement ends automatically if New York Life’s participation agreements with the funds end. The agreement is governed by Massachusetts law and may not be assigned without consent, except to a successor transfer agent.
